news.titleEn: Nvidia and Wall Street Team Up on $500 Billion Bet on AI Infrastructure
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia struck financing deals with major Wall Street firms including Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to let AI infrastructure customers borrow more than $500 billion to build out data centers and compute capacity.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达联合华尔街巨头推出逾5000亿美元AI基础设施融资计划。
news.whyEn: The deal treats AI hardware and infrastructure as a new investable asset class, potentially unlocking massive new capital for the AI buildout while raising questions about debt-fueled overexpansion.
news.whyZh: 该计划把AI硬件基础设施变成新的投资资产类别，为AI建设注入巨额资本，但也引发对债务驱动过度扩张的担忧。
news.detailEn: Nvidia has partnered with some of the biggest names in finance — Apollo Global Management, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR — to create financing platforms that will let its customers borrow more than half a trillion dollars to build AI data centers and buy computing capacity. For the first time, these investors are treating AI hardware and infrastructure as an asset class comparable to stocks, bonds and commodities, opening a new channel of capital beyond traditional corporate balance sheets. The financing is partly designed to help smaller, capital-constrained AI startups access the compute they need without waiting to raise equity. The announcement lands alongside a broader wave of AI-related debt issuance, with JPMorgan projecting tech-sector bond sales could exceed $500 billion in 2026 as hyperscalers ramp capital expenditure toward nearly $700 billion for the year. The scale of the financing underscores how central Nvidia has become not just as a chipmaker but as an orchestrator of AI capital markets.
news.detailZh: 英伟达与金融界多家巨头——阿波罗全球管理、贝莱德、黑石、博枫、高盛与KKR——达成合作，推出多个融资平台，让其客户可借入超过5000亿美元资金用于建设AI数据中心和采购算力。这些投资机构首次将AI硬件与基础设施视为可与股票、债券、大宗商品相提并论的独立资产类别，为AI建设开辟了传统企业资产负债表之外的新融资渠道。该融资计划的部分目的，是帮助资本实力较弱的AI初创公司无需等待股权融资即可获得所需算力。该消息公布之际，AI相关债务发行正迎来更广泛的浪潮，摩根大通预计2026年科技行业债券发行规模可能超过5000亿美元，超大规模云服务商今年资本支出将逼近7000亿美元。此次融资规模之大，凸显英伟达已不仅是芯片制造商，更成为AI资本市场的核心组织者。

news.titleEn: Anthropic Meets Investors to Shore Up Confidence Ahead of Planned September IPO
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic, valued at $965 billion, is holding meetings with prospective investors as it targets a September or early-October IPO that could rank among the largest in history.
news.conclusionZh: 估值9650亿美元的Anthropic正筹备9月至10月初IPO，或成史上最大规模上市案之一。
news.whyEn: A mega-IPO of this scale would be a landmark test of investor appetite for AI companies and could reshape the competitive and capital landscape between Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI labs.
news.whyZh: 如此规模的超级IPO将成为投资者对AI公司信心的重要试金石，并可能重塑AI实验室间的竞争与资本格局。
news.detailEn: Anthropic, an AI safety company valued at $965 billion after its most recent funding round, is holding a series of meetings with prospective investors as it prepares for what could become the largest initial public offering in history, targeting a listing in September or early October — ahead of rival OpenAI, whose own IPO may not arrive until next year. In these preliminary meetings, potential investors have pressed Anthropic executives on the threat from cheaper Chinese AI models, tensions with the Trump administration, and growing public opposition to new data center construction across the US. Company leaders, including CEO Dario Amodei, have argued that most users continue to prefer the most capable AI systems available and that Chinese models still lag top-tier offerings by several months. The roadshow reflects broader uncertainty in the AI sector about which companies will ultimately lead and how financially durable today's AI valuations will prove to be.
news.detailZh: AI安全公司Anthropic在最近一轮融资后估值达9650亿美元，目前正与多家潜在投资者举行会晤，为可能成为史上规模最大的首次公开募股做准备，计划于9月至10月初上市，抢在竞争对手OpenAI（其IPO可能要等到明年）之前登陆资本市场。在这些前期会晤中，潜在投资者向Anthropic高层追问了来自中国低成本AI模型的竞争威胁、与特朗普政府的紧张关系，以及美国国内对新建数据中心日益增长的反对声浪。以首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪为首的公司管理层则回应称，大多数用户仍然更青睐能力最强的AI系统，且中国模型的能力仍落后顶尖产品数月之久。此次路演也折射出AI行业更广泛的不确定性——市场尚不确定最终由谁引领行业，也不确定当前AI估值的财务可持续性究竟如何。

news.titleEn: Intel Upsizes Stock Offering to $20 Billion at $95 a Share as AI Demand Accelerates
news.conclusionEn: Intel raised its equity offering to $20 billion, pricing 210.5 million shares at $95 each, to fund its push into contract chip manufacturing and meet surging AI-driven demand.
news.conclusionZh: 英特尔将增发股票融资规模上调至200亿美元，每股定价95美元。
news.whyEn: The unusually large capital raise, upsized from an initial $15 billion after drawing more than $100 billion in demand, signals strong investor confidence in Intel's foundry turnaround and its role in the AI chip boom.
news.whyZh: 融资规模从最初150亿美元上调至200亿美元，认购需求超1000亿美元，显示市场对英特尔代工业务转型的信心。
news.detailEn: Intel priced an underwritten public offering of 210,526,315 shares of common stock at $95 per share, upsizing the deal from an originally announced $15 billion to $20 billion after the offering drew more than $100 billion in investor demand. Net proceeds of roughly $19.7 billion will go toward expanding manufacturing capacity, advancing process technology, and supporting Intel's push to attract external foundry customers amid skyrocketing demand for AI computing power. Analysts, including Bank of America's Vivek Arya, framed the raise as a bullish signal for Intel's foundry business rather than a sign of financial distress, arguing it reflects growing customer conviction in Intel's manufacturing roadmap. The move follows a sharp rally in Intel's stock this year and adds Intel to a growing list of chipmakers raising fresh capital to keep pace with AI infrastructure buildout.
news.detailZh: 英特尔以每股95美元的价格完成2.10526315亿股普通股的承销发行，融资规模从最初宣布的150亿美元上调至200亿美元，此前该发行吸引了超过1000亿美元的投资者认购需求。约197亿美元的净募集资金将用于扩大制造产能、推进制程技术，并支持英特尔在AI算力需求飙升背景下吸引外部代工客户的战略。美国银行分析师Vivek Arya等人将此次融资视为英特尔代工业务的利好信号，而非财务困境的迹象，认为这反映出客户对英特尔制造路线图信心的增强。此举延续了英特尔股价今年以来的强劲上涨势头，也使其加入了越来越多为跟上AI基础设施建设步伐而融资的芯片制造商行列。

news.titleEn: July CPI Shows Inflation Cooling to 3.4%, Below Forecasts
news.conclusionEn: US consumer prices rose 0.1% in July, bringing annual inflation down to 3.4% and coming in below the 3.5% Wall Street had expected, reducing the odds of an imminent Fed rate hike.
news.conclusionZh: 美国7月CPI同比降至3.4%，低于预期，加息紧迫性降低。
news.whyEn: Softer-than-expected inflation gives the Federal Reserve more room to hold off on raising rates, directly influencing stock, bond and currency markets and borrowing costs for consumers and businesses.
news.whyZh: 通胀低于预期为美联储暂缓加息提供空间，直接影响股债汇市及企业和消费者借贷成本。
news.detailEn: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the Consumer Price Index rose a seasonally adjusted 0.1% in July, pulling the annual inflation rate down to 3.4% from 3.5% in June and coming in below the 3.5% economists polled by the Wall Street Journal had forecast. Core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.2% for the month and 2.5% year-over-year. Following the report, traders reduced the odds they had assigned to a Federal Reserve interest rate hike at its September meeting, as the data suggested price pressures are moderating even as they remain above the Fed's 2% target. Inflation still outpaced wage growth, which was running around 3.2% annually, meaning the report is a mixed signal: welcome relief for the Fed's inflation fight, but not yet a return to comfortable price stability for households.
news.detailZh: 美国劳工统计局数据显示，7月消费者价格指数季调后环比上升0.1%，将同比通胀率从6月的3.5%降至3.4%，低于《华尔街日报》调查的经济学家3.5%的预期。剔除波动较大的食品和能源价格后，核心CPI当月环比上升0.2%，同比上升2.5%。数据公布后，交易员下调了对美联储9月会议加息的预期概率，因为数据显示价格压力正在缓和，尽管仍高于美联储2%的目标水平。通胀率仍高于约3.2%的年度工资增速，这意味着该报告释放的是喜忧参半的信号：对美联储抗击通胀而言是可喜的缓解，但对普通家庭而言物价尚未回归舒适稳定的水平。

news.titleEn: Wendy's Stock Jumps 12% on Report of Nelson Peltz Take-Private Bid
news.conclusionEn: Wendy's shares surged as much as 15% after reports that activist investor Nelson Peltz's Trian Fund Management, alongside BlueFive Capital and Flynn Group, is preparing a bid to take the struggling fast-food chain private.
news.conclusionZh: 传彼得兹旗下Trian拟联合财团将温迪私有化，股价一度飙升15%。
news.whyEn: The bid comes as Wendy's fundamentals deteriorate — same-restaurant sales fell 7% last quarter and the company slashed its dividend — making it a test case for whether activist-led buyouts can turn around struggling legacy restaurant chains.
news.whyZh: 温迪业绩恶化、股利遭腰斩，此次收购将检验维权投资者能否扭转老牌连锁餐饮困境。
news.detailEn: Shares of Wendy's jumped as much as 15% and were briefly halted for volatility after the Financial Times reported that Nelson Peltz's Trian Fund Management is preparing a bid to take the fast-food chain private. Peltz personally holds about a 16% stake and Trian's fund holds roughly 7.9% more, giving the group a combined stake near 24%. The consortium is expected to include Abu Dhabi-based BlueFive Capital, known for backing luxury brands like Bugatti, and Flynn Group, the world's largest restaurant franchise operator and one of Wendy's biggest franchisees with more than 300 locations. Wendy's said it would "thoroughly review any proposal submitted by Trian" consistent with its fiduciary duties, but no formal offer price has been disclosed. The approach comes just days after Wendy's reported weak second-quarter results, withdrawing its full-year guidance and cutting its dividend in half after same-restaurant sales fell 7% year-over-year, with CEO Bob Wright acknowledging the company is "clearly not performing at our potential."
news.detailZh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，彼得兹旗下Trian Fund Management正筹备将这家快餐连锁企业私有化的收购方案，消息传出后温迪股价一度飙升15%，并因波动过大而短暂停牌。彼得兹个人持股约16%，Trian基金另持约7.9%，双方合计持股接近24%。该财团预计还将包括总部位于阿布扎比、以投资布加迪等奢侈品牌著称的BlueFive Capital，以及全球最大餐饮特许经营商、温迪最大加盟商之一（旗下逾300家门店）的Flynn Group。温迪表示将「按照信义义务，认真审阅Trian提交的任何方案」，但尚未披露具体报价。此次收购意向出台前几天，温迪刚公布疲软的第二季度业绩：撤回全年业绩指引、将股息削减一半，同店销售额同比下滑7%，首席执行官鲍勃·赖特承认公司「显然未发挥出应有潜力」。

news.titleEn: Blackstone-Owned Safe Harbor Nears $1.5 Billion Deal to Buy MarineMax
news.conclusionEn: Blackstone Infrastructure's Safe Harbor Marinas is nearing a roughly $1.5 billion deal, including debt, to acquire boat retailer MarineMax at about $53 a share in cash, beating out rival bidders Donerail and Centerbridge.
news.conclusionZh: 黑石旗下Safe Harbor拟以约53美元/股、总额约15亿美元收购游艇零售商MarineMax。
news.whyEn: The deal would unite the world's largest marina operator with a major boat retailer, marking Safe Harbor's biggest transaction since Blackstone bought it for $5.7 billion last year and signaling continued private-equity appetite for consumer leisure assets.
news.whyZh: 交易将全球最大船坞运营商与主要游艇零售商合并，反映私募股权对休闲消费资产的持续兴趣。
news.detailEn: Blackstone Infrastructure's Safe Harbor Marinas, the world's largest owner and operator of marinas, is nearing a deal to acquire MarineMax for about $53 a share in cash, a roughly 96% premium to its late-January closing price, valuing the recreational boat and yacht retailer's equity at around $1.17 billion and the total transaction, including debt, at about $1.5 billion. MarineMax operates 65 marinas and storage locations along with 70 dealerships catering to a wealthy clientele, mostly in the United States. Activist investor Donerail and private equity firm Centerbridge were also among the bidders in the final round before Safe Harbor emerged as the frontrunner. The deal would be Safe Harbor's largest since Blackstone Infrastructure bought the marina operator itself for $5.7 billion in a 2025 buyout, and would extend Safe Harbor's footprint across the US, Caribbean and Mediterranean by combining marina operations with MarineMax's retail and service network.
news.detailZh: 黑石基础设施旗下的Safe Harbor Marinas是全球最大的船坞拥有者和运营商，目前正接近以每股约53美元现金收购MarineMax，较其1月末收盘价溢价约96%，令这家休闲游艇零售商的股权估值约11.7亿美元，加上债务的交易总额约为15亿美元。MarineMax在美国为主的地区运营65个船坞及仓储地点，并拥有70家经销门店，客户主要为高净值人群。维权投资者Donerail与私募股权公司Centerbridge此前也曾进入最后一轮竞购，但最终Safe Harbor胜出。若交易达成，将是Safe Harbor自身在2025年被黑石基础设施以57亿美元收购以来最大的一笔并购，也将把Safe Harbor在美国、加勒比海及地中海的船坞业务与MarineMax的零售服务网络相结合，进一步扩大版图。

news.titleEn: Over 2,500 Organizations Impacted by LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
news.conclusionEn: A March 2026 supply-chain attack on the widely used open-source AI proxy LiteLLM has been found to have exposed credentials and secrets from more than 2,500 organizations, including Nvidia, Cisco and other major firms, across roughly 434,000 CI/CD pipelines.
news.conclusionZh: LiteLLM供应链攻击波及超2500家机构，涉及英伟达、思科等企业。
news.whyEn: As one of the largest AI infrastructure breaches on record, it exposed cloud credentials and API keys across thousands of companies' development pipelines, prompting an FBI warning that stolen data could still be weaponized in future attacks.
news.whyZh: 此次AI基础设施史上最大规模泄露之一暴露大量云凭证与API密钥，FBI警告数据或被用于后续攻击。
news.detailEn: Security researchers at CloudSEK have traced a March 2026 supply-chain attack to the open-source LiteLLM project, which is widely used as a proxy layer for connecting applications to AI models. The threat group known as Team PCP first compromised the build pipeline of Trivy, a popular open-source vulnerability scanner, and used that foothold to push two compromised versions of LiteLLM — 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 — to the PyPI package repository, where the tampered code remained live for roughly 20 days. Organizations that pulled the compromised packages into their CI/CD systems had environment variables, cloud credentials, API tokens and configuration files harvested; CloudSEK linked more than 118,000 exposed CI runner dumps to 2,488 corporate domains, with high-confidence matches including Nvidia, Cisco, Salesforce, Siemens, X Corp and Orange. The FBI issued a flash advisory in July warning that actors behind the campaign are likely to continue weaponizing the stolen credentials well after the initial breach, and researchers say the incident illustrates how deeply AI development tooling has become embedded in — and vulnerable through — everyday software supply chains.
news.detailZh: 网络安全研究机构CloudSEK追踪发现，2026年3月发生的一起供应链攻击源头指向开源项目LiteLLM——该项目被广泛用作应用程序连接AI模型的代理层。名为「Team PCP」的黑客组织先攻陷了知名开源漏洞扫描工具Trivy的构建流水线，并借此立足点向PyPI软件包仓库推送了两个被植入后门的LiteLLM版本（1.82.7和1.82.8），被篡改的代码在约20天内持续可下载。将这些受污染软件包引入自身CI/CD系统的机构，其环境变量、云凭证、API令牌及配置文件遭到窃取；CloudSEK将超过11.8万份泄露的CI运行数据关联至2488个企业域名，其中高置信度匹配对象包括英伟达、思科、Salesforce、西门子、X公司及Orange等。FBI已于7月发布紧急通报，警告该攻击行动背后的黑客可能在初次入侵后很长时间内持续利用窃取的凭证发动攻击，研究人员表示，此事件凸显AI开发工具已深度嵌入日常软件供应链，也因此带来了相应的脆弱性。

news.titleEn: Strait of Hormuz Traffic Remains Low as World Burns Through Oil Stockpiles
news.conclusionEn: Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains minimal despite President Trump's claims the strait is open, as the IEA warns global oil stockpiles are being drawn down rapidly and Iran signals it could prolong the standoff until Trump leaves office.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹海峡通行量仍低迷，IEA警告全球石油库存加速消耗。
news.whyEn: Continued disruption at one of the world's most critical oil chokepoints keeps upward pressure on energy markets and prolongs uncertainty for global shipping and trade routes.
news.whyZh: 全球最重要石油通道持续受阻，令能源市场承压，全球航运与贸易路线不确定性延续。
news.detailEn: Despite President Trump's insistence that the Strait of Hormuz is open and under US control, actual shipping traffic through the waterway remains minuscule, and the International Energy Agency has warned that global oil stockpiles are being depleted at a rapid pace as a result. Iran said earlier in the week it was close to a temporary arrangement with Oman on routing tanker traffic through the strait, but a senior Iranian official reiterated that the passage will not fully reopen until the US agrees to end hostilities and provide financial compensation. Compounding the uncertainty, an adviser to the commander of Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps suggested Tehran could seek to "prolong" the standoff with Washington until after Trump leaves office. The strait normally carries about a fifth of global oil trade, and the prolonged disruption has kept energy markets on edge even as broader equity markets have rallied on hopes of an eventual resolution.
news.detailZh: 尽管特朗普总统坚称霍尔木兹海峡已经开放并处于美国控制之下，但该水道的实际航运量仍然微乎其微，国际能源署警告称，全球石油库存正因此被快速消耗。伊朗本周早些时候曾表示，已接近与阿曼就油轮通行安排达成临时协议，但一名伊朗高级官员重申，除非美方同意结束敌对行动并提供经济补偿，否则该海峡不会完全重新开放。局势的不确定性因伊朗革命卫队指挥官的一名顾问的表态而进一步加剧——该顾问暗示德黑兰或寻求将与华盛顿的对峙「拖延」至特朗普卸任之后。该海峡通常承担全球约五分之一的石油贸易，持续的中断使能源市场保持紧张，尽管更广泛的股市已因对最终解决的期待而走高。

news.titleEn: One Million Evacuated as Typhoon Dolphin Pummels East China
news.conclusionEn: Typhoon Dolphin, the strongest tropical cyclone to hit China this year, made landfall in Zhejiang province with 151 km/h winds, forcing more than one million evacuations and grounding roughly 40% of Shanghai's flights.
news.conclusionZh: 今年最强台风「海豚」登陆浙江，逾百万人撤离，上海约四成航班取消。
news.whyEn: The storm's scale — over a million evacuees, mass flight cancellations and warnings of major flooding as it moves inland — highlights the growing economic and humanitarian toll of intensifying typhoon seasons on densely populated coastal China.
news.whyZh: 台风造成大规模人员撤离与航班取消，凸显日益极端的台风季对中国沿海地区的经济与民生冲击。
news.detailEn: Typhoon Dolphin, described as the most powerful tropical cyclone to strike China so far this year, made landfall near Yuhuan in eastern Zhejiang province with maximum sustained winds of 151 km/h (93 mph), equivalent to a Category 1 hurricane. More than one million people were evacuated across the affected region, including roughly 900,000 in Wenzhou, 390,000 in Taizhou, nearly 99,000 in Fujian province, and about 30,300 in Shanghai, where roughly 40% of flights — around 1,400 in total — were grounded and 55 ferry routes suspended. As the storm tracked westward and weakened while moving over central and southwestern China, meteorologists warned that its slower inland movement could prolong heavy rainfall, with parts of Zhejiang expected to see 250-500mm of rain, raising the risk of major river flooding and landslides in mountainous areas.
news.detailZh: 台风「海豚」被称为今年以来登陆中国最强的热带气旋，在浙江省东部玉环附近登陆，中心附近最大持续风速达151公里/小时（93英里/小时），相当于一级飓风强度。受影响地区超过百万人撤离，其中温州约90万人、台州约39万人、福建省近9.9万人、上海约3.03万人；上海约四成航班（共约1400班）被取消，55条渡轮航线暂停运营。随着风暴向西移动并在穿越中国中西南部时逐渐减弱，气象部门警告，其减速内陆移动可能延长强降雨时间，浙江部分地区预计降雨量达250至500毫米，山区面临严重河流洪水及山体滑坡风险。

businessTips.explanationEn: An economic moat is a company's sustainable competitive advantage that protects its long-term profits and market share from competitors, much like a moat protects a castle. Moats can come from brand strength, network effects, high switching costs, patents, or cost advantages that are difficult for rivals to replicate. Investors and executives use the concept to judge how durable a company's earnings power is likely to be over time, not just how good its current numbers look.
businessTips.explanationZh: 经济护城河是指企业能够长期抵御竞争对手、保护自身利润与市场份额的可持续竞争优势，就像护城河保护城堡一样。护城河可能来自品牌力量、网络效应、高转换成本、专利，或是对手难以复制的成本优势。投资者和管理者用这一概念判断企业盈利能力的持久性，而不仅仅看当下的业绩数字。
businessTips.exampleEn: Nvidia's dominance in AI chips, reinforced by its CUDA software ecosystem that developers have spent years building on top of, creates high switching costs that function as a moat — even well-funded rivals struggle to lure customers away.
businessTips.exampleZh: 英伟达在AI芯片领域的主导地位，加上开发者多年投入构建的CUDA软件生态，形成了极高的转换成本，构成一道护城河——即便资金雄厚的对手，也很难把客户争取过去。

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer Acquisition Cost is the total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers gained over a given period, showing how much it actually costs a business to win each new customer. For a side hustle or early-stage startup, tracking CAC is critical because it's easy to spend more acquiring a customer than that customer will ever generate in revenue, quietly draining a business even as sales appear to grow. A healthy business generally wants the lifetime value of a customer to be several times higher than its acquisition cost.
businessTips.explanationZh: 客户获取成本（CAC）是指在一定时期内，销售与营销总支出除以新增客户数量，反映企业获取每位新客户的实际成本。对于副业或早期创业者而言，追踪CAC至关重要，因为很容易出现「获客成本高于该客户带来的收入」的情况，即使表面上销售在增长，实际却在悄悄亏钱。健康的业务通常希望客户终身价值能达到获客成本的数倍以上。
businessTips.exampleEn: A founder running paid ads for a $30 handmade candle spends $25 to acquire each customer through social media ads; unless repeat purchases push that customer's lifetime value well above $25, the ad spend is quietly destroying the business's margins.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位创业者为售价30美元的手工蜡烛投放社交媒体广告，每获取一位客户需花费25美元；除非复购能把该客户的终身价值大幅推高到25美元以上，否则这笔广告支出正在悄悄侵蚀企业的利润空间。

businessTips.explanationEn: A yield curve plots interest rates on government bonds of different maturities, and it normally slopes upward since investors demand higher yields for locking up money longer. An inversion occurs when short-term bonds yield more than long-term ones, which historically has been one of the more reliable warning signs of an upcoming economic slowdown or recession, because it suggests investors expect the central bank to cut rates in the future in response to weaker growth. Investors watch the spread between 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields especially closely as a recession indicator.
businessTips.explanationZh: 收益率曲线描绘了不同期限政府债券的利率水平，正常情况下应向上倾斜，因为投资者对锁定资金时间更长的债券要求更高回报。当短期债券收益率高于长期债券时，就出现了「收益率曲线倒挂」，历史上这是预示经济放缓或衰退较为可靠的信号之一，因为它意味着投资者预期央行未来将因经济走弱而降息。投资者尤其密切关注2年期与10年期美债收益率之差，将其作为衰退指标。
businessTips.exampleEn: With this week's cooler-than-expected CPI report raising the odds the Fed holds off on rate hikes, bond investors are watching whether the yield curve steepens back to normal or inverts again as a signal of where the economy is headed next.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周低于预期的CPI数据提高了美联储暂缓加息的可能性，债券投资者正密切关注收益率曲线是重新恢复正常陡峭形态，还是再度倒挂，以此判断经济下一步走向。
